answer.thought: The headlines speak of petitions against police excesses and a political figure adding weight to a protest. The tension is visible: the particular will of the individual, claiming liberty, clashes with the universal authority of the state. I must observe how the public opinion is forming here; it is the atmosphere in which the ethical idea breathes, or suffocates.
